name: year
description: Reference year of the observation

name: qtr
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4

name: area_fips
description: County FIPS code (5-digit)

name: own_code
description: Ownership code identifying the sector (private, federal, state, local government)

name: industry_code
description: Industry code (NAICS, supersector, or aggregate pseudo-code)
observations: Real NAICS codes align with br_bd_diretorios_us.naics_2022; aggregate and supersector codes are QCEW-specific

name: agglvl_code
description: Aggregation-level code indicating the geographic and industry summarization of the row

name: size_code
description: Establishment size-class code, 0 for all sizes

name: disclosure_code
description: Disclosure flag: N when the figure is not disclosable, blank otherwise

name: qtrly_estabs
description: Count of establishments in the quarter

name: month1_emplvl
description: Employment level in the first month of the quarter

name: month2_emplvl
description: Employment level in the second month of the quarter

name: month3_emplvl
description: Employment level in the third month of the quarter

name: total_qtrly_wages
description: Total wages paid in the quarter

name: taxable_qtrly_wages
description: Wages subject to unemployment-insurance taxation in the quarter

name: qtrly_contributions
description: Unemployment-insurance contributions in the quarter

name: avg_wkly_wage
description: Average weekly wage in the quarter

name: lq_disclosure_code
description: Disclosure flag for the location quotient: N when not disclosable, blank otherwise

name: lq_qtrly_estabs
description: Location quotient of the establishment count relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_month1_emplvl
description: Location quotient of first-month employment relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_month2_emplvl
description: Location quotient of second-month employment relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_month3_emplvl
description: Location quotient of third-month employment relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_total_qtrly_wages
description: Location quotient of total quarterly wages relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_taxable_qtrly_wages
description: Location quotient of taxable quarterly wages relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_qtrly_contributions
description: Location quotient of quarterly contributions relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_avg_wkly_wage
description: Location quotient of the average weekly wage relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: oty_disclosure_code
description: Disclosure flag for the over-the-year change: N when not disclosable, blank otherwise

name: oty_qtrly_estabs_chg
